market: • Our fair price: Lucas Gabriel is a 45% shot to win (fair odds +120).
• FanDuel pays +120, right at or a hair above fair. Best number on the board.
• The sharp line has been moving our way.
• Only FanDuel has this price, so it may not last.

points: Gabriel is 6-0 in ONE, including a split decision over former ONE lightweight champ Ok Rae Yoon. He has never been finished in the promotion.
Magomedov is a late replacement for the injured Alibeg Rasulov and is making his ONE debut in the main event in Bangkok.
Magomedov missed weight at 175.4 lbs, 5.4 over the limit, and forfeits 30% of his purse. Gabriel made weight at 167.8.
Gabriel has beaten several wrestling-heavy opponents, and his BJJ black belt guard is a real counter to Magomedov's takedown game.
Sharp-market fair price is +120, so the number is fair and the sharp line has moved toward Gabriel.
research.risk: Magomedov's wrestling and crucifix control, plus a size edge from missing weight, could take Gabriel's guard away early.
research.angle: Unbeaten-in-ONE Gabriel at plus money vs a short-notice debutant who missed weight; sharp money is on him.
context: Both fighters are healthy and the bout is on. The weight miss was settled with compensation, so it goes ahead at a 175.4 lb catchweight.
Indoor card at Lumpinee Stadium in Bangkok. Gabriel trains at Nova União Phuket in Thailand, so he has little travel or time-zone cost.
Gabriel says he has changed little for Magomedov because his style is similar to Rasulov's. He is targeting a finish and a title shot.
Magomedov is 15-0 with five straight finishes. Six of his nine finishes came in round 1, so he is a real early threat.
Public lean favors Magomedov: Tapology community picks are 79% Magomedov, 21% Gabriel. That is a fan poll, not sharp money.
Earlier prices at other books were Gabriel +100 to +120, Magomedov -130 to -142, so the +120 here is the top of the market.
